text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having obtained tickets to the zoo, I went 
along with Fenomeno, but—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W-What a massive crowd... Just moving 
forward is a struggle, sir.

text_block_list.name: Zoo Employee
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! This way is one-way only! If 
you'd like to see the baby lions...

text_block_list.name: Zoo Employee
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry! To reach the souvenir 
shop, you will have to take a detour past 
the petting zoo area...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I cannot overlook this, sir...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, might this officer be allowed 
to lend a hand as well?

text_block_list.name: Zoo Employee
text_block_list.text:
N-No, but still, we can't ask a customer 
to do that... No, I guess we don't have a 
choice.

text_block_list.name: Zoo Employee
text_block_list.text: Sorry, just do whatever you can, please!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Attention, guests! Those who wish to see 
the baby lion, please line up to the 
right!

text_block_list.name: Attendee
text_block_list.text: Oh, they say it's this way!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Excuse meee! A guest in a wheelchair is 
coming through, so please make some room!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The end of the baby lion line is right 
here! Please make sure not to block the 
lines for other animals, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Fenomeno's proper line 
management, the congestion cleared up 
considerably.

text_block_list.name: Zoo Employee
text_block_list.text:
You've been a huge help! Everything is 
fine here now, so please, go enjoy the 
park.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'm truly glad I could be of assistance.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Come, Boss, let us also go to see the lion 
cub.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... How adorable... Come, closer, 
even closer...!

text_block_list.name: Lion Cub
text_block_list.text: Kyu!? Kyu... kyuuuun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As soon as it saw Fenomeno, the baby lion 
trotted away...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To think... even the King of Beasts would 
fear me...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! It's not a problem! I'm really not 
that down about it!
choice_data_list: ...Is that so? Are you really alright?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Boss. Look at that.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: The baby was sooooo cute~!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Right, that's wonderful. I was worried 
when it got so crowded, but it's all 
thanks to that Umamusume lady.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, miss! Everyone just 
whooshed past like that!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
If you meet the older girl, make sure you 
thank her properly.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...What a truly magnificent sight.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Surely she learned today that there are 
people who will step in to help those in 
trouble...?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As long as there's a memory in the corner 
of your heart that someone like that 
existed...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Someday, she might choose to stand up for 
the sake of someone in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...That is why, no matter how much they 
fear me, I can carry out justice without a 
shred of doubt!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to create a future where 
everyone can live with kindness in their 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
B-Boss... Are you not praising me a bit 
too much...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Still, hearing you say that fills me with 
the deepest gratitude!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I will strive to remain the Boss's pride 
and joy from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I-I cannot thank you enough for such 
incredibly encouraging words!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If you say so, Boss, then I will surely be 
all right.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I will carry out my justice without 
hesitation!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Is that so, sir?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, I fall short in far too many ways 
right now to achieve that.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Until that day comes, I have to keep 
giving it my all!
